in_marathi.name: Hemali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hemali is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hem' meaning 'sun' and 'al' meaning 'rays'. It symbolizes the radiant energy of the sun and the power of its rays. In Hindu mythology, the sun god Surya is often depicted as having a chariot pulled by seven horses, each representing a day of the week. Hemali is a feminine name and is considered to be a beautiful and powerful name for a girl.
